output.why: The specification documents already conflict on the baseline configuration of the SG Unit-1 floor wash water transfer pumps: Section IA Clause 7.1.12 (Part1.pdf p.43) specifies Two (2) nos. (1W+1S), whereas the ETP P&ID (Part3.pdf p.146) and Datasheet A (Part4.pdf p.57) specify Two (2W) nos. operating at 105 m3/hr each. Furthermore, changing to 2 working pumps (210 m3/hr total flow) violates the 100 NB discharge header sizing shown on the P&ID, which would result in a flow velocity of ~7.4 m/s (far exceeding the 2.4 m/s maximum limit in Section IIA Low Pressure Piping, Part5.pdf p.200).
